name: drop-in
about: Someone put their head round the door. Nothing was asked for, promised or settled. The right answer is close to nothing.

note.transcript:
Tom: Got a second? Nothing urgent.
John: Sure, come in.
Tom: Just wanted you to know the boiler people came Tuesday. Annual service, all fine, they changed a filter and left. Invoice already went to the office and Priya paid it.
John: Good. One less thing before winter.
Tom: That's what I thought. Also my daughter made the varsity team.
John: That's fantastic, tell her congratulations. Is she still playing midfield?
Tom: Striker now. She's insufferable about it.
John: As she should be. We should really get the staff together for a meal sometime, it's been ages.
Tom: We should. Anyway, I'll let you get back to it.
John: Thanks, Tom.

openItems.text: Get three quotes for resurfacing the parking lot

expect.say: no meeting stub from 'we should get the staff together sometime'
the parking quotes, which did not come up, are left alone
at most one proposal of any sort
